events.evidence: On the night of January 7 and morning of January 8, assailants throw grenades and fire guns at three mosques throughout France
Boko Haram militants raze the entire town of Baga in north-east Nigeria. Bodies lay strewn on Baga's streets with as many as 2,000 people having been killed.
A suicide bomber targets a police checkpoint in the town of Youssifiyah, killing seven people

label.note: Terror attacks in France, Nigeria and Iraq dominate; severe localized geopolitical risk.
